items.title: NVDA momentum factor ranks in top decile among mega-cap semiconductors
items.snippet: NVIDIA's 6-month price momentum places it in the 85th percentile of its peer group, driven by sustained AI infrastructure demand and data center revenue growth.

items.title: Short interest in NVDA remains subdued despite elevated valuations
items.snippet: Short interest as a percentage of float sits at just 1.2%, with days-to-cover under 1 day, suggesting limited conviction among bearish positioning despite the stock's stretched valuation multiples.

items.title: NVDA implied volatility spikes ahead of earnings, vol regime shifts to stressed
items.snippet: Options markets are pricing elevated uncertainty for NVIDIA ahead of its May earnings report, with 30-day implied volatility at 48% and the vol regime classification moving to stressed territory.
